Daily coffee drinkers can rack up serious points with this one.Free Coffee OffersValid till: April 6, 2026Triple Birthday Bonus PointsCelebrate your birthday with a 3X points boost on your entire purchase. This is not limited to just one item. Everything you buy during your birthday window earns triple the points. The bonus applies the day before, the day of, and the day after your birthday. Just make sure your birthday is saved in your Dunkin’ Rewards profile. You get this gift once a year and it is a great way to stock up on points.Valid till: April 23, 2026How to Use a Dunkin’ Promo Code (Step-by-Step)Not sure where to enter your Dunkin’ coupon code? Here’s exactly how to redeem it — whether you’re using the app or the website.On the Dunkin’ AppOpen the Dunkin’ app and sign in to your Rewards account.Add your items ( coffee, donuts, sandwiches, etc.) to your cart.Tap “Checkout” when you’re ready.Look for the “Add Promo Code” field on the checkout screen.Type or paste your promo code and tap “Apply.”You’ll see the discount applied instantly before you pay. That’s it!Dunkin' Donuts CouponsOn DunkinDonuts.comVisit DunkinDonuts.com and browse K-Cups, coffee bags, or drinkware.Add items to your shopping cart.At checkout, find the “Promo Code” or “Discount Code” box.Enter your code and click “Apply.”The discount will be reflected in your order total.💡 Pro Tip: Dunkin’ only allows one promo code per order, so always pick the code that saves you the most. However, you can stack a promo code with your Dunkin’ Rewards points for extra savings!Dunkin’ Rewards (DD Perks) — Your Secret Weapon for Free CoffeeIf you’re a regular Dunkin’ customer and you’re not using the Dunkin’ Rewards program, you’re literally leaving free coffee on the table. I use this every single day, and I’ve saved hundreds over the past year. Here’s how it works.Cashback OffersHow Dunkin’ Rewards Points WorkEarn 10 points for every $1 you spendBoosted members earn 12 points per $1 (see below)Earn 3× points on your birthday (the day before, day of, and day after). (Valid till April 23, 2026)Get a free welcome drink (medium coffee or tea) just for signing upCheck the “Offers” tab every Monday — that’s where app-exclusive deals like $1 medium coffees and free donut Fridays appearDunkin’ Rewards Redemption Chart (Updated April 2026)Here is a complete breakdown of every reward tier in the Dunkin’ Rewards program. I have listed them from lowest to highest so you can see exactly how close you are to your next freebie.Points NeededRewardValid Till150 points3 count Munchkins or Espresso Shot—250 pointsDonut or Muffin—300 pointsFree Classic DonutApril 23, 2026400 pointsHot or Iced Coffee / Tea—500 pointsFree Bagel or Dunkin’ BitesJune 25, 2026600 pointsFree Coffee or Tea (Any Size)May 14, 2026800 pointsBreakfast Sandwich—Free Classic Donut (300 Points)Redeem just 300 points and get any classic donut for free. This is the lowest point tier for a food reward which makes it the easiest freebie to reach. If you spend around $30 at Dunkin’, you will already have enough points to grab a free donut. It is a great way to treat yourself without spending extra.CoffeeValid till: April 23, 2026Free Bagels or Dunkin’ Bites (500 Points)Use 500 points to get a free bagel or a side of Dunkin’ Bites. This is a solid option if you want something more filling than a donut. A plain or everything bagel pairs perfectly with your morning coffee. You will need to spend about $50 at Dunkin’ to hit this tier, which most regular customers reach within a few weeks.Valid till: June 25, 2026Free Coffee or Tea of Any Size (600 Points)Trade in 600 reward points for any size hot or iced coffee or tea. This reward covers all sizes including large, so you get the maximum value for your points. At 10 points per dollar, you will need about $60 in total spending to earn this free drink. It is a simple and satisfying way to enjoy your favorite Dunkin’ beverage on the house.Valid till: May 14, 2026How to Get Boosted StatusMake 12 qualifying visits (at least 60 minutes apart) within a single calendar month, and your account automatically upgrades to Boosted status for 3 months. Boosted members earn 12 points per $1 instead of 10 — which means you hit free-drink thresholds faster.Tea💡 7 Ways to Save at Dunkin’ Without a Promo CodeSometimes the best Dunkin’ Donuts deals don’t need a code at all. Here are my favorite tricks that I use every week.Always Check Your ReceiptFlip your receipt over — there’s often a link to a guest satisfaction survey. It takes 2 minutes, and they’ll give you a coupon for a free donut with your next medium or large drink purchase. I do this every single time.Follow Them on InstagramI follow Dunkin’ on Instagram, and sometimes they post a surprise one-day deal right in their stories. It’s an easy way to catch a special offer.Ask About Local In-Store DealsMy local Dunkin’ had a sign in the window for a $3 Refresher deal after 2 PM. These don’t always show up in the app, so keep your eyes open when you walk in!Free Coffee OffersBring Your Own TumblerSome Dunkin’ locations give you a small discount (usually $0.10–$0.25 off) for bringing a reusable cup. It’s not huge, but over a year of daily coffee, it adds up.Use Delivery App Promo CodesIf you order Dunkin’ through Uber Eats, DoorDash, or Grubhub, look for platform-specific promo codes. These apps frequently offer first-order discounts or free delivery deals.Stack Rewards Points with Promo CodesHere’s a trick most people don’t know: you can use a promo code and earn Dunkin’ Rewards points on the same order. You can’t stack two promo codes, but you can always stack one code + your points earning.Shop Discounted Gift CardsSites like Raise and Gift Card Granny sell Dunkin’ gift cards at 5–10% below face value. Buy a $50 Dunkin’ gift card for $45, then use it to pay for orders — instant savings on top of any promo code!Candy & Sweets⚠️ Why Your Dunkin’ Promo Code Isn’t Working (& How to Fix It)It’s frustrating when a Dunkin’ discount code doesn’t work. Before you give up, check these three things — they fix the problem 90% of the time.Check for Typos & Case SensitivitySome Dunkin’ promo codes are case-sensitive, meaning DUNKIN20 and dunkin20 might be treated differently. Double-check every letter.Make Sure It’s for App OrdersMany Dunkin’ codes are app-exclusive — they won’t work if you order at the counter. If a code isn’t working in-store, try placing a mobile order instead.Verify the Minimum Purchase RequirementSome codes require a minimum order amount (like $5 or $5.29). Also check that you have the right items in your cart — a “free latte” code won’t apply if you only have a regular coffee.Dunkin' Donuts CouponsRecently Expired Dunkin’ Donuts CouponsThese Dunkin’ discount codes have expired, but we keep them here for reference.
